Overview

The R package AirPolModChem provides a collection of useful functions and simple toy models as discussed during the ETH Zürich lecture Air Pollution Modeling and Chemistry in HS2026.

Installation

Direct installation from github can be done after installing R packages devtools or remotes:

install.packages("remotes")

Then installation can be started using

library(remotes)
install_github("ayanu/airpolmodchem")

Usage

The package contains several functions that are used for exercises in the lecture. For details refer to the function reference.

Getting help

Please refer to the package documentation first. If that does not solve your questions, contact the developer directly.
